item.title: Morning Brief — Monday, August 31, 2026
item.description: Today's three: One. Write your own take in one line before you open the chat. It's the only way to keep your ideas yours. Two. Steering beats rowing now. Ambition's the bottleneck, and n8n is the glue that wires your tools together. Three. The money's moving to the physical layer. a16z's billion-dollar hardware bet, and a China market the West keeps miscounting.
